input_protocol: Official Image.open.convert(RGB) and ToTensor, bilinear resize to 512 square with align_corners=True; no new LOG conversion. Dry-run requires exact pixel equality with old identity arms.
render_protocol: Full keys/values attention with query chunk512; full context formed before channel attention. Bilinear context upsample to original dimensions align_corners=True; two RGB LUTs blended per pixel, CUDA-index-equivalent CPU reference, binsize1.000001/(dim-1). Official ToPILImage truncation for new PNGs. Standard LUT operation retained.
g0: Same fused LUT, context replaced by scalar mean of full-resolution upsampled context; no additional network forward.
attempt_policy: One frozen three-photo queue; no image substitution, no automatic retry after any attempt, retain incomplete/failure outputs and all baseline arms. Supervisor samples its own worker process tree every0.1s, conservatively sums per-process peak RSS under4GiB, and terminates only PID/create-time-verified owned descendants and root on cap/time breach.
scope: Internal noncommercial consumed-photo reference-response ablation: only reference18 replaced with manifest-first reference02. Same author/series; not broad style validation, calibrated film, independent or native RAW validation. Legacy old_ncc arm remains reference18 and is not the matched reference-response comparator.
review: Compare fixed source0/1/2 under reference18 vs02 in both SA-LUT and G0. Mere output difference proves sensitivity only; direction must be checked against visible reference change. Keep visible transformation priority and label distortion. No tuning, attenuation or best-of selection.
